# Creative Work Title

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CreativeWorkTitle>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An appellation borne by a creative work — a document title, article headline, dataset name, or media title. Carries its own [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md) and [`gmeow:nameScript`](../properties/gmeow-nameScript.md) so co-equal multilingual titles (e.g. 'The Matrix' / '黑客帝国') are separate first-class objects, never alternateName subordinates.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a structured, language- and script-tagged title borne by a creative work when co-equal multilingual titles must each be a first-class object — an original and its translation, a romanization.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the 80% case of a single plain title (use the flat [`gmeow:title`](../properties/gmeow-title.md) literal) and avoid demoting a translated title to an alternateName subordinate — co-equal titles are separate objects ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint one [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md) per title, carry [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md) / [`gmeow:nameScript`](../properties/gmeow-nameScript.md) on it, and link it to the work with [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md); mark a superseded title [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false rather than deleting it.

### Examples

- ex:titleEn a [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md); [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md) ex:languageEnglish. ex:work [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:titleEn.
